entries.a41a1c601a773cd5: Under the vision 'Spreading happiness born from diverse dining experiences across Japan and to the world,' the company's management policy is the steady execution of its new medium-term management plan and the promotion of efforts toward non-continuous growth. It states that it aims to become an innovative food platform, and while strengthening and expanding its existing core businesses, it continues to take on challenges in new areas for new growth. As priority issues, it cites raising name recognition, responding to new technologies including generative AI, stable operation and strengthening of systems, and strengthening of its management and internal control systems.

entries.e77cf5248774e3f1: A business that supports business succession for restaurants. It provides M&A brokerage such as business transfers and share transfers, and support services for inuki transfers, in which a restaurant vacates the premises leaving its equipment and fixtures in place. "Inshoku M&A by Inshokuten.com" is operated by the company and its consolidated subsidiary Wit Co., Ltd., which also operate the "Food Accounting Association", a support organization for accounting firms whose clients include restaurants. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥277 million.
